changes.comment: A shared folder that appeared from another of your devices says what it is doing — arriving, waiting for its link, or being folded back — instead of appearing and disappearing.
Pasting the link for a shared folder that is waiting for one starts it syncing where it stands: nothing is re-downloaded and no file on disk changes.
The root of a shared folder can no longer be renamed, moved, deleted or shared again from the file tree — each refusal says why, where you asked.
Sharing a folder now records which vault it came from, so a device you link later opens that folder without you pasting its link.
A vault link and a folder link are told apart when stored, so a folder's key can never be used to reach the whole vault.
Stopping sharing a folder no longer leaves the vault itself disconnected from your other devices until the next restart.
